info.title: v2.returns.dispute
info.description: Dispute return. Support to raise dispute when return_status in REQUESTED / PROCESSING/ACCEPTED

post.description: Dispute return. Support to raise dispute when return_status in REQUESTED / PROCESSING/ACCEPTED

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: dispute_reason_id
parameters.description: The dispute reason id. Please call v2.returns.get_return_dispute_reason to get it.

parameters.name: dispute_text_reason
parameters.example: Received return item(s), buyer's claim incorrect

parameters.name: image_list
parameters.description: Determines whether image submission is mandatory for the dispute request - mandatory input field for all dispute reasons except "Did not receive the return product".

parameters.name: image_url
parameters.description: The image URLs of current evidence module. It is recommended to pass in the URL returned by convert_image API.

parameters.name: module_index
parameters.description: The module_index of current evidence module returned by get_return_dispute_reason API.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: requirement
parameters.description: The requirement content of current evidence module returned by get_return_dispute_reason API.
parameters.example: Photo(s) or Video of unboxing the returned parcel with the consignment note (Airway Bill).

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/returns/dispute?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "dispute_reason_id": 50,
    "dispute_text_reason": "Received return item(s), buyer\\'s claim incorrect",
    "email": "test@example.com",
    "image_list": [
        {
            "image_url": [
                "https://fileproxy.scsusercontent.com/api/v2/files/c2hvcGVlLWRyYzAx/bf10d801_e9c9e5473d3345d08671a8cc3bc1a6de.jpg",
                "https://fileproxy.scsusercontent.com/api/v2/files/c2hvcGVlLWRyYzAx/bf10d801_1733e9f051994b56ae748d4ebd40d0ee.jpg"
            ],
            "module_index": 1,
            "requirement": "Photo(s) or Video of unboxing the returned parcel with the consignment note (Airway Bill)."
        }
    ],
    "return_sn": "24112301K66SQXM"
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
